Cli.Help.zh:
破晓资源提取工具 (dawn)

用法: dawn <命令> [选项]

  info                            显示安装目录、哈希表与名称索引状态
  scan   [--root 路径] [--json 文件]
                                  扫描全部 wad，输出条目数量与压缩方式
  list   <wad 名称或通配符> [--root 路径] [--filter 通配符] [--category 类别]
         [--ext 扩展名] [--path 目录前缀] [--limit N] [--json 文件]
                                  列出某个 wad（或匹配的一组 wad）的条目
  extract [--root 路径] [--wad 通配符] [--out 目录] [--filter 通配符]
         [--category 类别] [--ext 扩展名] [--path 目录前缀] [--min-size 字节] [--max-size 字节]
         [--threads N] [--flat] [--overwrite] [--dry-run] [--no-unnamed]
         [--audio mp3|wav|keep] [--raw]
                                  批量导出条目（默认跳过已导出过的文件）
                                  贴图默认转 PNG，音频默认转 MP3；--audio keep 或
                                  --raw 保留 wad 里的原始格式
  media  [--root 路径] [--wad 通配符] [--out 目录] [--filter 通配符]
         [--path 目录前缀] [--flat] [--overwrite] [--dry-run]
                                  只导出二次解析后的媒体：贴图转 PNG，音频转 MP3
                                  其余条目（模型、数据等）不导出
  catalog [--root 路径] [--json 文件] [--bucket 名称] [--search 文字] [--limit N]
                                  按客户端数据表把条目归到 英雄/皮肤/装备/符文/…，
                                  输出各分类的条目数（--bucket 只看一类，
                                  --search 试搜路径，--json 存明细）
  hashes fetch [--token T] [--dir 目录] [--build]
                                  下载 CommunityDragon 哈希表（约 217MB，9 个分片）
  hashes build [--dir 目录] [--out 文件] [--root 路径 --scope]
                                  由文本哈希表生成二进制名称索引（--scope 只保留本地 wad 用到的项）
  hashes stats                    统计哈希表与索引规模

公共选项: --data-dir 目录   覆盖工具数据目录（存放哈希表与索引）
          --root 路径       游戏 DATA 目录（默认读取上一次使用的配置）
          --lang zh|en      输出语言，默认 zh

--root 指到游戏 DATA 时只扫游戏包；指到安装根目录时，LeagueClient\plugins 下的
客户端包（英雄/装备文本、头像、原画）一起列出。

类别取值: texture, model, audio, video, bin, text, shader, other
Cli.Help.en:
Dawn Resource Extraction Tool (dawn)

Usage: dawn <command> [options]

  info                            Show the install folder and the state of the hash tables and name index
  scan   [--root path] [--json file]
                                  Scan every wad and report the entry count and the storage modes
  list   <wad name or wildcard> [--root path] [--filter wildcard] [--category name]
         [--ext extension] [--path folder prefix] [--limit N] [--json file]
                                  List the entries of one wad (or of a matching set of wads)
  extract [--root path] [--wad wildcard] [--out folder] [--filter wildcard]
         [--category name] [--ext extension] [--path folder prefix] [--min-size bytes] [--max-size bytes]
         [--threads N] [--flat] [--overwrite] [--dry-run] [--no-unnamed]
         [--audio mp3|wav|keep] [--raw]
                                  Export entries in bulk (files already exported are skipped)
                                  Textures become PNG and audio becomes MP3 by default; --audio keep
                                  or --raw keeps the format the wad holds
  media  [--root path] [--wad wildcard] [--out folder] [--filter wildcard]
         [--path folder prefix] [--flat] [--overwrite] [--dry-run]
                                  Export the second-pass media only: textures as PNG, audio as MP3;
                                  everything else (models, data, …) stays behind
  catalog [--root path] [--json file] [--bucket name] [--search text] [--limit N]
                                  Sort the entries into champion / skin / item / rune / … by the
                                  client tables and report how many landed in each (--bucket shows
                                  one section, --search tries a path, --json saves the details)
  hashes fetch [--token T] [--dir folder] [--build]
                                  Download the CommunityDragon hash tables (about 217MB, 9 parts)
  hashes build [--dir folder] [--out file] [--root path --scope]
                                  Build the binary name index from the text tables (--scope keeps
                                  only the entries the local wads use)
  hashes stats                    Report the size of the hash tables and the index

Common options: --data-dir folder   Overrides the tool data folder (hash tables and index)
                --root path         Game DATA folder (defaults to the last used one)
                --lang zh|en        Output language (zh by default)

A --root inside the game DATA scans the game wads only; a --root at the install folder also
lists the client wads below LeagueClient\plugins (champion and item text, icons, splash art).

Categories: texture, model, audio, video, bin, text, shader, other
